# testing_x_wrapped_attribute (Resource)

XWrappedAttribute Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_wrapped_attribute" "my_xwrappedattribute" {
  non_wrapped_string = "...my_non_wrapped_string..."
  wrapped_list_string = [
    "..."
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `wrapped_list_string` (List of String) Example wrapped request list of strings, such as a list of identifiers.

### Optional

- `non_wrapped_string` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `wrapper` (Attributes) OK (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wrapper))

Read-Only:

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_wrapped_attribute.my_testing_x_wrapped_attribute
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_wrapped_attribute.my_testing_x_wrapped_attribute "..."
```
